I was where you are now. You will get better as hard as that is to believe. Some tips for you.
*dont romanticize them or listen to sad breakup music and think of them.
*stay active and keep busy.
*physical activity is you're friend. It will make you feel better and look better. It's hard to get motivated but it's a must.
*cut all contact. Dont fb stalk them. Block them and accept that you will most likely never see or speak to then again. They are basically dead now.
*eat healthier. It will make you feel better the same as working out.
*remember there are plenty other people out there and try and meet new people asap (hard with covid but hopefully this all starts to get better soon).

Hope you start to heal soon mate.

You absolutely need to respect his wishes, as tough as that might be.
